class ModelCloudReviewRefused(BaseModel):
    """A text that is not a review, and why."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    reason: EnumCloudReviewRefusal
    detail: str = ""


def _column_zero(text: str) -> Iterator[str]:
    """Lines outside fenced blocks, so a quoted example is never read as metadata."""
    fence: str | None = None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith(("```", "~~~")):
            marker = stripped[:3]
            fence = marker if fence is None else (None if fence == marker else fence)
            continue
        if fence is None:
            yield line


def review_head(brief: str) -> str | None:
    """The head the brief asks the session to review (its first column-zero ``Review head:`` line), or None."""
    for line in _column_zero(brief):
        found = _HEAD_LINE.fullmatch(line)
        if found:
            head = found.group(1).lower()
            return head if _SHA.fullmatch(head) else None
    return None


def _refused(
    reason: EnumCloudReviewRefusal, detail: str = ""
) -> ModelCloudReviewRefused:
    return ModelCloudReviewRefused(reason=reason, detail=detail)


def parse_cloud_review(
    text: str,
    expected_head: str | None,
    source: Literal["final_message", "review_file"] = "final_message",
) -> ModelCloudReview | ModelCloudReviewRefused:
    """The review the text holds after its last marker line, or the typed reason it holds none.

    Error details name the rule that failed and never echo the reply's text."""
    if not text.strip():
        return _refused(EnumCloudReviewRefusal.NO_TEXT)
    if len(text) > FINAL_TEXT_MAX:
        return _refused(EnumCloudReviewRefusal.TOO_LONG, f"over {FINAL_TEXT_MAX} chars")
    markers = list(_MARKER_LINE.finditer(text))
    if not markers:
        return _refused(EnumCloudReviewRefusal.NO_MARKER, f"no {REVIEW_MARKER} line")
    last = markers[-1]
    head = last.group(1).lower()
    if not _SHA.fullmatch(head):
        return _refused(EnumCloudReviewRefusal.BAD_HEAD, "head is not 40 hex")
    if expected_head is not None and head != expected_head.lower():
        return _refused(
            EnumCloudReviewRefusal.HEAD_DIFFERS, "the review names another head"
        )
    body = _FENCE.sub("", text[last.end() :]).strip()
    try:
        payload, _end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(body)
    except ValueError:
        return _refused(
            EnumCloudReviewRefusal.NO_JSON, "no JSON object after the marker"
        )
    try:
        verdict = ModelCompactReviewVerdict.model_validate(payload)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        fields = sorted(
            {
                ".".join(str(part) for part in err["loc"]) or "<document>"
                for err in exc.errors(include_input=False, include_context=False)
            }
        )
        return _refused(EnumCloudReviewRefusal.SCHEMA, f"fields {fields}")
    if verdict.more:
        return _refused(
            EnumCloudReviewRefusal.MORE, "the reviewer had more findings than it listed"
        )
    return ModelCloudReview(
        head_sha=head,
        catalog_version=verdict.v,
        findings=tuple(
            ModelCloudReviewFinding(
                path=item.p,
                line=item.line,
                severity=SEVERITY_WORDS[item.s],
                claim=" ".join(
                    part for part in (item.c, item.y or "", item.n or "") if part
                ),
            )
            for item in verdict.f
        ),
        source=source,
    )


def read_session_review(
    final_text: str, file_text: str, expected_head: str | None
) -> ModelCloudReview | ModelCloudReviewRefused:
    """The review of the final message, else of the review file; the final message's refusal when neither holds one."""
    first = parse_cloud_review(final_text, expected_head, "final_message")
    if isinstance(first, ModelCloudReview) or not file_text.strip():
        return first
    second = parse_cloud_review(file_text, expected_head, "review_file")
    return second if isinstance(second, ModelCloudReview) else first


__all__ = [
    "FINAL_TEXT_MAX",
    "REVIEW_FILE",
    "REVIEW_HEAD_PREFIX",

```python
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 OmniNode.ai Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""The savings baseline when the caller named no session model.

``resolve_baseline_model`` takes the session model first. Without one, the
baseline is the configured ``pricing.baseline_model`` (the overlay, then the
store), then the model the developer has used most in the history the caller
passes, and only with none of those the fixed default. The history is a
mapping of model id to use count; a blank id or a count below one is not use.
A tie goes to the lowest model id, so the same history always names the same
baseline.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Literal

__all__ = ["BaselineSelectionCase", "configured_or_most_used"]

#: How a run's savings baseline was chosen; the receipt's ``baseline_source``.
BaselineSelectionCase = Literal[
    "session_model", "overlay", "store", "most_used", "fixed_default"
]


def _configured(config: object) -> str | None:
    if not isinstance(config, dict):
        return None
    pricing_config = config.get("pricing")
    if not isinstance(pricing_config, dict):
        return None
    candidate = pricing_config.get("baseline_model")
    if isinstance(candidate, str) and candidate.strip():
        return candidate.strip()
    return None


def _most_used(history: Mapping[str, int] | None) -> str | None:
    counts = {
        model.strip(): count
        for model, count in (history or {}).items()
        if isinstance(model, str) and model.strip() and count >= 1
    }
    if not counts:
        return None
    return min(counts, key=lambda model: (-counts[model], model))


def configured_or_most_used(
    overlay: object, store: object, history: Mapping[str, int] | None
) -> tuple[str, BaselineSelectionCase] | None:
    """The baseline and its case, or None when the fixed default applies."""
    for config, case in ((overlay, "overlay"), (store, "store")):
        model = _configured(config)
        if model is not None:
            return model, "overlay" if case == "overlay" else "store"
    most_used = _most_used(history)
    return (most_used, "most_used") if most_used is not None else None
```

```python
"""The caller's protocol table: which protocols exist and which node declares which."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Self

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, model_validator

from omnimarket.models.binding_conformance.model_binding_node_row import (
    ModelBindingNodeRow,

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    protocols: tuple[ModelBindingProtocol, ...]
    rows: tuple[ModelBindingNodeRow, ...]

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _consistent(self) -> Self:
        codes = [p.code for p in self.protocols]
        refs = [p.protocol for p in self.protocols]
        if len(set(codes)) != len(codes):
            raise ValueError("a protocol code appears twice in the table")
        if len(set(refs)) != len(refs):
            raise ValueError("a protocol import path appears twice in the table")
        nodes = [r.node for r in self.rows]
        if len(set(nodes)) != len(nodes):
            raise ValueError("a node has two rows in the table")
        for row in self.rows:
            unknown = sorted(set(row.protocols) - set(codes))
            if unknown:
                raise ValueError(f"row of {row.node} names unknown protocol {unknown}")
            if len(set(row.protocols)) != len(row.protocols):
                raise ValueError(f"row of {row.node} repeats a protocol")
        return self
```

```python
the source and no model default is added to what is stored. The loader validates it first through the

from __future__ import annotations

def document_digest(document: Mapping[str, JsonValue]) -> str:
    """The content hash: two documents with the same digest hold the same values."""
    canonical = json.dumps(document, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    loaded_by: str = Field(min_length=1)

    def _digest_is_the_documents(self) -> ModelOverlayStoreRecord:
        if not self.document:
            raise ValueError(f"overlay {self.overlay_id}: the document is empty")
        computed = document_digest(self.document)
        if computed != self.digest:
            raise ValueError(
                f"overlay {self.overlay_id}: digest {self.digest} is not the document's hash {computed}"
```

```python
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 OmniNode.ai Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""EFFECT: read one loaded overlay, keep this host's snapshot, say how the read went.

Placement must work when the store or the broker is down, so readers take the local snapshot and a
refresh keeps it. A refresh that cannot reach the store, or finds nothing or something invalid, leaves
the snapshot as it is. Past an overlay's bound the snapshot reads per that overlay's policy: ``read``
answers and every reading says stale, so a stale table is never silently refused and never silently
trusted; ``refuse`` raises. No usable snapshot reads as unreadable, with its reason.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Protocol

from pydantic import JsonValue, ValidationError

from omnimarket.handlers.node_overlay_reader import NodeOverlayError
from omnimarket.handlers.overlay_store.snapshot_root import (
    FileOverlaySnapshot,
    OverlaySnapshotError,
)
from omnimarket.models.overlay_store import (
    EnumOverlayReadSource,
    EnumOverlayReadState,
    ModelOverlayCompare,
    ModelOverlayDocumentRead,
    ModelOverlayReadPolicy,
    ModelOverlaySnapshotStamp,
    ModelOverlayStoreReading,
    ModelOverlayStoreRecord,
)

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from omnibase_spi.protocols.storage import ProtocolOverlayStore


class OverlayAbsentError(NodeOverlayError):
    """No usable snapshot of the overlay on this host."""


class OverlayStaleError(NodeOverlayError):
    """The overlay's policy refuses a read past its bound."""


class ProtocolOverlayReporter(Protocol):
    """Where a reading goes. A reporter that fails never fails the read."""

    async def report(self, reading: ModelOverlayStoreReading) -> None: ...


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


class HandlerOverlayStoreRead:
    """The refresh and the read, with every dependency injected."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        store: ProtocolOverlayStore,
        snapshot: FileOverlaySnapshot,
        reporter: ProtocolOverlayReporter,
        host: str,
        policies: Mapping[str, ModelOverlayReadPolicy],
        clock: Callable[[], datetime] = _utc_now,
    ) -> None:
        self._store = store
        self._snapshot = snapshot
        self._reporter = reporter
        self._host = host
        self._policies = policies
        self._clock = clock

    async def handle(self, overlay_id: str) -> ModelOverlayStoreReading:
        """One refresh of one overlay: the store's version into the snapshot, or why it stayed."""
        now = self._clock()
        store_error: str | None = None
        try:
            record = await self._store.read_current(overlay_id)
            if record is None:
                store_error = f"the store holds no overlay {overlay_id}"
            else:
                loaded = ModelOverlayStoreRecord.model_validate(record)
                if loaded.overlay_id != overlay_id:
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"asked for {overlay_id}, the store answered {loaded.overlay_id}"
                    )
                stamp = self._snapshot.write(loaded, written_at=now)
                reading = self._reading(
                    overlay_id, stamp, EnumOverlayReadSource.STORE, None, now=now
                )
                await self._report(reading)
                return reading
        except ValidationError as exc:
            store_error = f"the store's overlay is invalid: {exc.errors()[0]['msg']}"
        except (
            Exception
        ) as exc:  # any backend failure is one fact: the store did not answer
            store_error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
        reading = self.read(overlay_id, store_error=store_error)
        await self._report(reading)
        return reading

    async def refresh_all(self) -> tuple[ModelOverlayStoreReading, ...]:
        """One refresh of every overlay this host keeps."""
        return tuple([await self.handle(overlay_id) for overlay_id in self._policies])

    def read(
        self, overlay_id: str, *, store_error: str | None = None
    ) -> ModelOverlayStoreReading:
        """The snapshot as it stands, with its age against the bound. Touches no store."""
        now = self._clock()
        try:
            stamp = self._snapshot.read_stamp(overlay_id)
        except OverlaySnapshotError as exc:
            return ModelOverlayStoreReading(
                host=self._host,
                overlay_id=overlay_id,
                state=EnumOverlayReadState.UNREADABLE,
                stale_after_s=self._policy(overlay_id).stale_after_s,
                store_error=store_error,
                detail=str(exc),
                read_at=now,
            )
        return self._reading(
            overlay_id, stamp, EnumOverlayReadSource.SNAPSHOT, store_error, now=now
        )

    def read_document(self, overlay_id: str) -> ModelOverlayDocumentRead:
        """The document with its reading; absent raises, and stale raises where the policy refuses."""
        reading = self.read(overlay_id)
        if reading.state is EnumOverlayReadState.UNREADABLE:
            raise OverlayAbsentError(f"overlay {overlay_id}: {reading.detail}")
        if (
            reading.state is EnumOverlayReadState.STALE
            and self._policy(overlay_id).on_stale == "refuse"
        ):
            raise OverlayStaleError(f"overlay {overlay_id}: {reading.detail}")
        return ModelOverlayDocumentRead(
            document=self._snapshot.read_document(overlay_id), reading=reading
        )

    def _policy(self, overlay_id: str) -> ModelOverlayReadPolicy:
        policy = self._policies.get(overlay_id)
        if policy is None:
            raise NodeOverlayError(
                f"overlay {overlay_id}: this host keeps {sorted(self._policies)}"
            )
        return policy

    def _reading(
        self,
        overlay_id: str,
        stamp: ModelOverlaySnapshotStamp,
        source: EnumOverlayReadSource,
        store_error: str | None,
        *,
        now: datetime,
    ) -> ModelOverlayStoreReading:
        bound = self._policy(overlay_id).stale_after_s
        age = (now - stamp.loaded_at).total_seconds()
        stale = age > bound
        return ModelOverlayStoreReading(
            host=self._host,
            overlay_id=overlay_id,
            state=EnumOverlayReadState.STALE if stale else EnumOverlayReadState.FRESH,
            source=source,
            digest=stamp.digest,
            age_s=round(age, 1),
            stale_after_s=bound,
            store_error=store_error,
            detail=(
                f"source last asserted {age:.0f}s ago, over the {bound}s bound"
                if stale
                else ""
            ),
            read_at=now,
        )

    async def _report(self, reading: ModelOverlayStoreReading) -> None:
        try:
            await self._reporter.report(reading)
        except (
            Exception
        ) as exc:  # the read stands; a lost report is printed, never raised
            sys.stderr.write(
                f"overlay reading not reported: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}\n"
            )


def _row_key(row: object) -> str | None:
    return (
        str(row["name"])
        if isinstance(row, Mapping) and isinstance(row.get("name"), str)
        else None
    )


def _walk(
    left: JsonValue,
    right: JsonValue,
    path: str,
    differing: list[str],
    counts: list[int],
) -> None:
    counts[0] += 1
    if isinstance(left, Mapping) and isinstance(right, Mapping):
        for key in sorted(set(left) | set(right)):
            where = f"{path}.{key}" if path else key
            if key not in left or key not in right:
                differing.append(where)
            else:
                _walk(left[key], right[key], where, differing, counts)
        return
    if isinstance(left, list) and isinstance(right, list):
        keys_left = [_row_key(item) for item in left]
        keys_right = [_row_key(item) for item in right]
        if all(keys_left) and all(keys_right) and left and right:
            counts[1] += len(left)
            if keys_left != keys_right:
                differing.append(f"{path}.<row order or names>")
            by_name = dict(zip(keys_right, right, strict=True))
            for name, row in zip(keys_left, left, strict=True):
                if name in by_name:
                    _walk(row, by_name[name], f"{path}.{name}", differing, counts)
            return
        if len(left) != len(right):
            differing.append(f"{path}.<length>")
            return
        for index, (one, other) in enumerate(zip(left, right, strict=True)):
            _walk(one, other, f"{path}[{index}]", differing, counts)
        return
    if left != right or type(left) is not type(right):
        differing.append(path)


def compare_documents(
    source: Mapping[str, JsonValue], stored: Mapping[str, JsonValue]
) -> ModelOverlayCompare:
    """Column by column, with a list of named rows compared row by row and by name."""
    differing: list[str] = []
    counts = [0, 0]
    _walk(dict(source), dict(stored), "", differing, counts)
    return ModelOverlayCompare(
        equal=not differing,
        paths_compared=counts[0],
        rows_compared=counts[1],
        differing=tuple(differing),
    )


__all__ = [
    "HandlerOverlayStoreRead",
    "OverlayAbsentError",
    "OverlayStaleError",
    "ProtocolOverlayReporter",
    "compare_documents",
]
```

```python
"""``python -m omnimarket.nodes.node_overlay_store_read_effect``: refresh, read, compare, fleet.

Binds the handler to the backend the overlay selects. ``read``, ``compare`` and :func:`read_overlay`
touch neither broker nor database, so they answer when both are down.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import json
import os
import sys
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
from importlib import resources
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import yaml

from omnimarket.handlers.node_overlay_reader import (
    NodeOverlayError,
    load_structured_overlay,
)
from omnimarket.handlers.overlay_store.bus_opener import open_lane_bus, workspace_root
from omnimarket.handlers.overlay_store.snapshot_root import FileOverlaySnapshot
from omnimarket.handlers.overlay_store.store_bus_snapshot import BusSnapshotOverlayStore
from omnimarket.handlers.overlay_store.store_in_memory import InMemoryOverlayStore
from omnimarket.models.overlay_store import (
    EnumOverlayReadState,
    ModelOverlayDocumentRead,
    ModelOverlayStoreReading,
    ModelOverlayStoreReadOverlay,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_overlay_store_read_effect.handlers import (
    HandlerOverlayStoreRead,
    compare_documents,
)

NODE = "node_overlay_store_read_effect"
EXIT_UNREADABLE = 65
EXIT_DIFFERS = 1


def _contract() -> dict[str, Any]:
    text = (
        resources.files(f"omnimarket.nodes.{NODE}")
        .joinpath("contract.yaml")
        .read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    )
    return dict(yaml.safe_load(text))


def _snapshot(overlay: ModelOverlayStoreReadOverlay) -> FileOverlaySnapshot:
    return FileOverlaySnapshot(Path(os.path.expanduser(overlay.snapshot_root)))


class _BusReporter:
    """Publishes each reading on the contract's topic; the floor reads the newest of each host."""

    def __init__(self, open_bus: Any, topic: str) -> None:
        self._open_bus = open_bus
        self._topic = topic

    async def report(self, reading: ModelOverlayStoreReading) -> None:
        async with self._open_bus() as bus:
            await bus.publish(
                self._topic,
                f"{reading.host}:{reading.overlay_id}".encode(),
                reading.model_dump_json().encode("utf-8"),
            )


class _NoReporter:
    async def report(self, reading: ModelOverlayStoreReading) -> None:
        return None


def _in_memory_store(
    overlay: ModelOverlayStoreReadOverlay,
    host: str,
    kafka_bootstrap: str | None,
    env: Mapping[str, str],
) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
    return InMemoryOverlayStore(), _NoReporter()


def _postgres_store(
    overlay: ModelOverlayStoreReadOverlay,
    host: str,
    kafka_bootstrap: str | None,
    env: Mapping[str, str],
) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
    raise NodeOverlayError(
        f"{NODE}: the postgres backend belongs to a runtime, which binds its own pool"
    )


def _bus_snapshot_store(
    overlay: ModelOverlayStoreReadOverlay,
    host: str,
    kafka_bootstrap: str | None,
    env: Mapping[str, str],
) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
    contract = _contract()
    bootstrap = kafka_bootstrap or overlay.kafka_bootstrap

    def open_bus() -> Any:
        return open_lane_bus(
            bus="kafka",
            lane=None if bootstrap else overlay.bus_lane,
            kafka_bootstrap=bootstrap,
            root=workspace_root(env),
        )

    return (
        BusSnapshotOverlayStore(
            open_bus=open_bus,
            topic=contract["snapshot_read"]["topic"],
            group_prefix=f"{NODE}.{host}",
            window_s=overlay.read_window_s,
        ),
        _BusReporter(open_bus, contract["event_bus"]["publish_topics"][0]),
    )


_BACKENDS: Mapping[str, Callable[..., tuple[Any, Any]]] = {
    "in_memory": _in_memory_store,
    "postgres": _postgres_store,
    "bus_snapshot": _bus_snapshot_store,
}


def build_handler(
    overlay: ModelOverlayStoreReadOverlay,
    env: Mapping[str, str],
    *,
    kafka_bootstrap: str | None = None,
) -> HandlerOverlayStoreRead:
    """The handler the overlay selects. A runtime holds the postgres backend; a host never does."""
    host = env.get(overlay.host_name_env, "").strip()
    if not host:
        raise NodeOverlayError(f"{NODE}: {overlay.host_name_env} is not set")
    store, reporter = _BACKENDS[overlay.backend](overlay, host, kafka_bootstrap, env)
    return HandlerOverlayStoreRead(
        store=store,
        snapshot=_snapshot(overlay),
        reporter=reporter,
        host=host,
        policies=overlay.overlays,
    )


def read_overlay(
    overlay_id: str, environ: Mapping[str, str] | None = None
) -> ModelOverlayDocumentRead:
    """The one read a consumer takes. Touches no broker or database.

    Raises ``OverlayAbsentError`` with no usable snapshot, and ``OverlayStaleError`` past the bound of
    an overlay whose policy refuses.
    """
    env = os.environ if environ is None else environ
    overlay = load_structured_overlay(NODE, ModelOverlayStoreReadOverlay, env)
    return HandlerOverlayStoreRead(
        store=InMemoryOverlayStore(),
        snapshot=_snapshot(overlay),
        reporter=_NoReporter(),
        host=env.get(overlay.host_name_env, ""),
        policies=overlay.overlays,
    ).read_document(overlay_id)


def _print(payload: Any) -> None:
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def exit_for(readings: tuple[ModelOverlayStoreReading, ...]) -> int:
    unreadable = any(r.state is EnumOverlayReadState.UNREADABLE for r in readings)
    return EXIT_UNREADABLE if unreadable else 0


async def fleet(
    overlay: ModelOverlayStoreReadOverlay,
    env: Mapping[str, str],
    kafka_bootstrap: str | None,
    group: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The newest reading of each host and overlay on the bus: the floor row's source.

    Without ``group`` the topic is read from its earliest offset under a fresh consumer group, so a window
    that ends before the log does answers with a frozen past: the topic gains a reading per host every tick
    and a slow link read the first 2,730 of 3,526 in the window (measured), leaving every host's newest
    reading stuck at the same offset. With ``group`` the consumer group is stable and its position is
    committed on the broker, so a window that ends early resumes at the next tick and the answer holds the
    readings published since the last one; the caller folds that over the record it already holds."""
    newest: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    async def on_message(message: Any) -> None:
        reading = json.loads(bytes(message.value).decode("utf-8"))
        key = f"{reading['host']}:{reading['overlay_id']}"
        held = newest.get(key)
        if held is None or held["read_at"] <= reading["read_at"]:
            newest[key] = reading

    bootstrap = kafka_bootstrap or overlay.kafka_bootstrap
    async with open_lane_bus(
        bus="kafka",
        lane=None if bootstrap else overlay.bus_lane,
        kafka_bootstrap=bootstrap,
        root=workspace_root(env),
    ) as bus:
        stop = await bus.subscribe(
            _contract()["event_bus"]["publish_topics"][0],
            on_message=on_message,
            group_id=f"{NODE}.fleet.{group or uuid.uuid4().hex}",
            auto_offset_reset="earliest",
        )
        try:
            await asyncio.sleep(overlay.read_window_s)
        finally:
            await stop()
    return {"readings": newest}


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=NODE, description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("verb", choices=("refresh", "read", "compare", "fleet"))
    parser.add_argument("--id", help="read, compare: the overlay id")
    parser.add_argument("--file", type=Path, help="compare: the source file")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--kafka-bootstrap",
        default=None,
        help="the broker, stated directly; default the overlay's lane",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, help="fleet: also write the answer here")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    env = os.environ
    try:
        overlay = load_structured_overlay(NODE, ModelOverlayStoreReadOverlay, env)
        handler = build_handler(overlay, env, kafka_bootstrap=args.kafka_bootstrap)
    except NodeOverlayError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(f"{NODE}: {exc}\n")
        return EXIT_UNREADABLE
    if args.verb == "refresh":
        readings = asyncio.run(handler.refresh_all())
        _print([r.model_dump(mode="json") for r in readings])
        return exit_for(readings)
    if args.verb == "fleet":
        answer = asyncio.run(fleet(overlay, env, args.kafka_bootstrap))
        _print(answer)
        if args.out is not None:
            args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            args.out.write_text(json.dumps(answer, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        return 0
    if not args.id:
        parser.error(f"{args.verb} needs --id")
    if args.verb == "read":
        reading = handler.read(args.id)
        _print(reading.model_dump(mode="json"))
        return exit_for((reading,))
    if args.file is None:
        parser.error("compare needs --file")
    compared = compare_documents(
        yaml.safe_load(args.file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")),
        _snapshot(overlay).read_document(args.id),
    )
    _print(compared.model_dump(mode="json"))
    return 0 if compared.equal else EXIT_DIFFERS


__all__ = [
    "EXIT_UNREADABLE",
    "NODE",
    "build_handler",
    "exit_for",
    "fleet",
    "main",
    "read_overlay",
]
```

```python
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""One tick of a host's overlay store reader, the unit the host installer renders.

Refreshes every overlay this host keeps, then writes the fleet record the floor reads when the overlay
names one. The unit passes ``--omni-home`` and ``--state-dir``. A store that does not answer is a reading,
not a failed tick: only a host with no usable snapshot exits non-zero.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import faulthandler
import json
import os
import sys
from collections.abc import Mapping
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from omnimarket.handlers.floor_projection import publish_envelope
from omnimarket.handlers.node_overlay_reader import (
    NodeOverlayError,
    load_structured_overlay,
)
from omnimarket.handlers.overlay_store.bus_opener import open_lane_bus, workspace_root
from omnimarket.models.floor_projection import ModelFloorProjectionEnvelope
from omnimarket.models.overlay_store import ModelOverlayStoreReadOverlay
from omnimarket.nodes.node_overlay_store_read_effect.runtime_overlay_store_read import (
    EXIT_UNREADABLE,
    NODE,
    _contract,
    build_handler,
    exit_for,
    fleet,
)


def tick_deadline_s() -> float:
    """The contract's bound on one tick; past it the process ends and the next tick starts clean."""
    return float(_contract()["descriptor"]["timeout_ms"]) / 1000


def _write_atomically(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    held = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    held.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    held.replace(path)


def _held_readings(held: Path) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    """The readings the last tick wrote; none when the record is absent or cannot be parsed."""
    try:
        readings = json.loads(held.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["readings"]
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
        return {}
    return dict(readings) if isinstance(readings, dict) else {}


def _newer(
    held: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], read: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]]
) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    """The held readings with each read one laid over it when it is not older."""
    merged = dict(held)
    for key, reading in read.items():
        kept = merged.get(key)
        if kept is None or str(kept.get("read_at", "")) <= str(
            reading.get("read_at", "")
        ):
            merged[key] = dict(reading)
    return merged


def _fleet_record(
    overlay: ModelOverlayStoreReadOverlay,
    env: Mapping[str, str],
    held: Path,
    own: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The newest reading of each host on the bus, with this host's own over it.

    The bus is read under this host's own consumer group, so each tick takes up where the last one stopped and
    the readings it finds are laid over the record the last tick wrote. A broker that is down can carry no
    reading, so this host's own says so and the others stay as last read."""
    readings = _held_readings(held)
    host = env.get(overlay.host_name_env, "").strip()
    try:
        answer: dict[str, Any] = asyncio.run(fleet(overlay, env, None, host))
        readings = _newer(readings, answer["readings"])
    except Exception as exc:  # the store down is the case this record exists to show
        sys.stderr.write(f"{NODE}: fleet not read: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}\n")
    for reading in own:
        readings[f"{reading['host']}:{reading['overlay_id']}"] = reading
    return {"readings": readings}


async def _publish_fleet_projection(
    overlay: ModelOverlayStoreReadOverlay,
    env: Mapping[str, str],
    fleet_record: Mapping[str, Any],
    now: datetime,
) -> None:
    """This host's view of the fleet as a floor projection, stamped with the time this tick stood by it (OMN-23391).

    The floor reads the newest view any host published, so one host's stalled tick leaves the others' views in place and
    the projection ages only when every host's tick has stopped. The overlay accepts the id only on the broker backend."""
    if overlay.fleet_projection_id is None:
        return
    bootstrap = overlay.kafka_bootstrap
    host = env.get(overlay.host_name_env, "").strip()
    async with open_lane_bus(
        bus="kafka",
        lane=None if bootstrap else overlay.bus_lane,
        kafka_bootstrap=bootstrap,
        root=workspace_root(env),
    ) as bus:
        await publish_envelope(
            bus,
            _contract()["fleet_projection"]["topic"],
            ModelFloorProjectionEnvelope(
                projection_id=overlay.fleet_projection_id,
                as_of=now,
                producer=f"{NODE}:{host}",
                payload=dict(fleet_record),
            ),
        )


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=f"{NODE}.tick", description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--omni-home", dest="registry_root", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--state-dir", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    env = os.environ
    # A consumer caught mid-join when its broker goes away can retry its coordinator forever, and a unit
    # manager starts no second tick while one runs: measured on a lab host, 18 minutes and counting.
    faulthandler.dump_traceback_later(tick_deadline_s(), exit=True)
    # A tick run in-process must not leave the process-ending timer armed.
    try:
        try:
            overlay = load_structured_overlay(NODE, ModelOverlayStoreReadOverlay, env)
            handler = build_handler(overlay, env)
        except NodeOverlayError as exc:
            sys.stderr.write(f"{NODE}: {exc}\n")
            return EXIT_UNREADABLE
        readings = asyncio.run(handler.refresh_all())
        summary = [reading.model_dump(mode="json") for reading in readings]
        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
        if overlay.fleet_record_relpath:
            record = args.registry_root / overlay.fleet_record_relpath
            fleet_record = _fleet_record(overlay, env, record, summary)
            _write_atomically(record, json.dumps(fleet_record, indent=2))
            try:
                asyncio.run(
                    _publish_fleet_projection(
                        overlay, env, fleet_record, datetime.now(UTC)
                    )
                )
            except (
                Exception
            ) as exc:  # the broker down is the case the projection's age shows
                sys.stderr.write(
                    f"{NODE}: fleet projection not published: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}\n"
                )
        _write_atomically(
            args.state_dir / "last-run.json",
            json.dumps({"ran_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), "readings": summary}),
        )
        return exit_for(readings)
    finally:
        faulthandler.cancel_dump_traceback_later()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())


__all__ = ["main"]
```
